We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now were expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Marketing Engineer Your Role

As our Marketing Engineer, you sit at the intersection of data science and paid media. You'll consolidate scattered customer signals into a single source of truth, build ML models that score leads by their real value, and feed those insights back into our ad platforms - making our marketing smarter than the platforms' out-of-the-box optimization. It's a hands-on, build-from-scratch role with full ownership over both the models and the impact they create.

What to expect

 * Build our predictive CLTV modelling from the ground up: consolidate customer signals into a database, develop ML models on user behavior to score leads

 * Feed those scores back into the ad platforms (Meta, Google, and more) to sharpen targeting and bidding

 * Own tracking and conversion infrastructure: Tag Manager, Search Console, offline uploads, server-side setups

 * Turn raw behavioral data into measurable performance impact

 * Work closely with the Performance Marketing team and Go-to-Market managers

Who We're Looking For

 * You're comfortable building data pipelines and ML models - Python, SQL, and modern ML tooling are second nature

 * You understand paid media well enough to know what signals matter and how platforms consume them

 * Experience with attribution, conversion APIs, or offline conversion uploads is a strong plus

 * Hardworking, analytical, structured, and a natural fit for a direct, ambitious culture

 * Strong English skills, as English is our company language

 * German skills are a big plus

What We Offer

 * Competitive Salary: €65.000-€130.000

 * Equity - you build it, you should own a piece of it.

 * Food & drinks - at our Vienna office, lunch and dinner are on us (plus all the drinks your heart desires, and yes, we have protein bars and vitamins too).

 * Relocation bonus (if you still need to move to Vienna)

 * Equipment of your choice - whatever makes you happy.

 * Regular team offsites.

Hiring Process

 * 15 min intro call

 * 30 min skill interview

 * 15 min Culture fit with the founders

jobs.description:
PLATOGO - We are a diverse international team based in Vienna that values creativity, collaboration and innovation while building games in a fun and friendly environment.

We develop a highly polished, multi-platform gaming experience for millions of players worldwide. Our apps are translated into more than 13 languages and are top ranking in the app stores across the globe.

We are hiring! 1 Infrastructure Engineer with Expertise in Kubernetes and AWS (f/m/d) Vienna 1030, fulltime

Your tasks

 * Design, implement and manage infrastructure with Kubernetes and AWS

 * Collaborate with our Ruby/Elixir backend team to containerize applications and deploy them on Kubernetes

 * Optimize Kubernetes cluster performance, resource utilization, and cost-effectiveness

 * Implement and manage monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions with Grafana/Prometheus

 * Ensure the security of our environments by following best practices and implementing security controls

 * Automate Kubernetes deployment and management processes using Helm, Kustomize, Flux and Pulumi

 * Maintain service communication using Linkerd

 * Integrate application dependencies like RabbitMQ, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, Snowflake, DynamoDB

 * Help plan and take ownership of deploying and maintaining our internal tools

 * Deal with the challenges of an established and continuously growing project

Your profile

 * Proven experience as a Kubernetes engineer or similar role (e.g. DevOps engineer with Kubernetes focus)

 * Deep understanding of Kubernetes concepts, components, and APIs

 * Strong knowledge of Linux architecture and administration

 * Enjoy problem solving and have a keen eye for details

 * Thrive in a small, agile team environment

 * Love giving and receiving constructive feedback

 * Independent, precise, and well-organized work style

 * Enjoy to share knowledge and learn

 * Driven by the challenge of delivering high-performance and scalable solutions

 * Proficient in English; speaking German is a plus

Our Offer

 * Work on apps enjoyed by millions of users

 * Contribute your ideas and shape how we work together

 * Join a small team with a flat hierarchy

 * Enjoy flexible working hours

 * Thrive in a friendly work environment with various sports activities, monthly board game nights, and other fun events

 * Work in a rooftop office in the center of Vienna

 * Earn a yearly gross salary starting from € 60,000.- depending on your professional experience and qualifications

OPTIMUSE is a Vienna-based AI startup revolutionizing the real estate and construction industry. We br... 1 Software Engineer - Engine Integration (m/f/d) Job description
Our Product Engineers are domain experts first, developers second. They build Engines - the simulations and models that capture how buildings actually behave - fast, and increasingly with AI. But these prototypes live on GitHub and only run on laptops: untested against the platform, unavailable to customers.

That's the gap you close. You're the key counterpart to our Product Engineers: you understand what an Engine computes, how, and why - well enough to decide where each piece belongs, hand off what belongs to other teams, and build the rest yourself. No finished spec lands in your inbox. You read other people's code, ask the right questions, and turn a working prototype into a service we can run and trust. We work in a strongly agentic way - so will you.

Your mission
 * Run our Engines and make them better - correct, fast, observable. When results look wrong, you can tell whether it's the data, the integration, or the physics.

 * Onboard new prototypes - understand the method and edge cases; judge what's production-ready and what needs a rewrite.

 * Find the right home for each function - decompose monoliths and define the interfaces and data contracts that make those boundaries real.

 * Integrate - with Planning and our Systems Architects, translating between domain and platform language, then build what remains yourself.

 * Make the next Engine easier than the last - shape the conventions that let prototypes arrive closer to integration-ready.

You won't do this alone: DevOps, App/Experience, AI, and Data & Flows already own their domains.

Your profile
 * Several years of professional software engineering across the stack, centre of gravity in the backend.

 * Python and TypeScript - strong in one, comfortable in the other, attached to neither.

 * The ability to read and judge code you didn't write, including scientific and numerical code.

 * A low-ego, collaborative style with domain experts, and the skill to explain trade-offs to people who think in physics, not architecture.

 * Professional English. German is a plus, not a requirement.

Nice-to-have

 * Geometry in code (computational geometry, meshes, CAD or BIM/IFC).

 * Simulation and numerical methods (thermal/energy simulation, FEM/CFD, solvers).

 * Real experience with AI and agentic workflows.

 * Productionizing research or prototype code (ML pipelines, scientific computing, quant models).

 * Building-industry or energy-domain exposure.

Why us?
 * Real impact. The Engines you integrate don't sit in a demo - they feed real investment decisions and move the platform forward in tangible ways.

 * The full solution chain. From digital twin to performance monitoring - you work across a complete product portfolio, not isolated one-off projects. Every Engine you bring in has a real place in the whole.

 * Flexible working models. Home-office option and a modern office in the heart of Vienna.

 * And the day-to-day works too. Daily meal allowance (€5/day), regular team events, free snacks.

 * Compensation: €60,000 - €75,000 gross/year, depending on your experience.

About us
OPTIMUSE is a Vienna-based AI startup revolutionizing the real estate and construction industry. We bring insights to the world's largest asset class that it never had before - both for new developments and existing portfolios. Our AI Hans delivers instant, deep engineering insight into costs, risks and optimization potential, grounded in building physics, simulation and engineering. Backed by international investors and a team of ~25 people from around 10 nations. Become a part of it!

1 In-House Programmatic Specialist (all genders)
1210 Wien, Job-ID: pze3wyxz 

Your responsibilities

 * End-to-End Campaign Trading & Optimization
You manage the daily setup, pacing, bidding strategies, and optimization of all programmatic display, video, audio, and connected TV (CTV) campaigns. You leverage platform-native bidding algorithms, frequency capping, and custom rules/scripts to consistently hit performance KPIs.
 * Marketplace Management & Publisher Relations
You negotiate directly with supply-side platforms (SSPs) and premium publishers to secure Private Marketplace (PMP) deals and Programmatic Guaranteed (PG) deals that drive efficiency and scale for our campaigns.
 * Creative Management & Ad Operations
You traffic and manage creatives via CM360 (Google stack) or Trade Desk's native creative library, ensuring proper ad serving, rotation, and format compliance across display, video (VAST/VPAID), audio, and CTV formats.
 * Measurement, Attribution & Performance Dashboards
You build transparent, automated performance dashboards to track media costs, tech fees, and platform margins. You implement and maintain conversion measurement using Floodlight activities, CM360 attribution models, and/or Trade Desk Universal Pixel & conversion events.
 * Stakeholder Communication & Community Leadership
You translate complex programmatic data into clear business insights for internal teams (Marketing, Creative, Leadership). You actively contribute to our internal Programmatic Community and share expertise across the organization.

Your qualifications

 * Deep Programmatic Trading Experience
You bring 3+ years of hands-on programmatic trading experience, with at least 2 years of intensive, daily work inside a DSP platform. Proficiency in one platform is required; working knowledge of multiple platforms is a strong advantage. Prior experience at a digital media agency or as a certified Google Marketing Platform (GMP) partner and/or Trade Desk certified partner is highly preferred.
 * Technical Expertise & Platform Mastery
You demonstrate complete fluency in Floodlight tags, CM360 container structures, URL parameters (Google stack) and/or Trade Desk Universal Pixel, conversion event configuration, and tracking parameters. You understand the technical architecture behind modern programmatic advertising.
 * Advanced Analytics & Problem-Solving
You possess advanced skills in data analytics with the ability to interpret complex datasets and translate them into actionable campaign strategies. You troubleshoot creative rejections, pixel drop-offs, and discrepancies across ad servers with ease and precision.
 * Communication & Team Collaboration
You communicate technical concepts clearly and effectively to non-technical stakeholders. You work independently and thrive as part of an English-speaking team, bringing both technical depth and interpersonal excellence. A Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a quantitative field is a plus.

Your perspective

Depending on the specific qualifications and professional experience, a gross monthly salary of at least EUR 4.000,- is envisaged (this in any case exceeds the minimum salary under the collective agreement). The final salary agreement will be reached in a personal meeting.

At our client you enjoy and value the freedom of a flexible mix of working from home and in the office. You will also benefit from a flat hierarchy and a transparent company structure. The position is available at the earliest possible entry date. This may best be discussed in a job interview.
